_meta.snapshot: SmartOptions snapshot 2026-07-25 (origin/main of samsej/sp500-screener, code at ec6b36e/10da1ee)
_meta.note: Definitions read from source code, not recomputed. Paths are in samsej/sp500-screener; line numbers are on origin/main.

Opportunity Score.plain: Ranks a put-selling setup 0-100: return, volatility, nearness to 52-week high and delta fit, scaled by company quality and risk.
Opportunity Score.formula: Score = (35*AnnualReturnScore + 25*IVScore + 20*DistanceScore + 20*DeltaFitScore)/100; Opportunity (CompositeScore) = min(100, Score x QualityMult x RiskMult), 0 if RiskTier=AVOID. QualityMult GREAT 1.15, GOOD 1.05, OK 1.00, WEAK 0.80, other/missing 1.0. RiskMult SAFE 1.10, WATCH 1.00, RISKY 0.75, missing 1.0.

AnnualReturnScore (component, 35%).plain: Put premium yield, annualized, scaled from 0 at 15% to 100 at 50%.

IVScore (component, 25%).plain: Implied volatility scaled from 0 at 30% to 100 at 120%; outside 30-120% scores 0.

DistanceScore (component, 20%).plain: Closer to the 52-week high scores higher: 100 at the high, 0 at 25% below it or when unknown.

DeltaFitScore (component, 20%).plain: How close the put's delta is to the 0.20 target: 100 on target, 0 when 0.15 or more away.

Quality score/tier.plain: 0-100 company health from profitability, growth, debt and valuation. Tiers: GREAT 80+, GOOD 65+, OK 50+, WEAK 35+, else AVOID.
Quality score/tier.formula: round(0.30*Profitability + 0.30*Growth + 0.25*BalanceSheet + 0.15*Valuation). Profitability=avg(ROE score, operating margin score); Growth=avg(EPS growth score, revenue growth score); BalanceSheet from debt/equity; Valuation from trailing (else forward) P/E. Missing input -> neutral sub-score (ROE/margin/revenue/valuation 50, EPS growth 40, debt 60). Data: yfinance .info.

TrendScore.plain: 0-100 price-trend health: above 200- and 50-day averages, RSI in a healthy range, and distance from those averages.
TrendScore.formula: round(0.35*SMA200pos + 0.25*SMA50pos + 0.20*RSIhealth + 0.10*pctVsSMA200 + 0.10*pctVsSMA50). Position: above 80, below 20, unknown 50. RSI sweet spot 45-65 scores 65-85, extremes lower. Any missing input -> 50.

Risk level.plain: SAFE, WATCH, RISKY or AVOID from trend and flags. AVOID means earnings within 14 days or weak fundamentals, and zeroes the Opportunity Score.
Risk level.formula: AVOID if EARNINGS_NEAR or LOW_QUALITY; else RISKY if BELOW_SMA200 or TrendScore<40; else WATCH if BELOW_SMA50, RSI_OVERBOUGHT, RSI_OVERSOLD or TrendScore<60; else SAFE.

Risk Flags.plain: Warnings on a stock: earnings within 14 days, below 200/50-day average, RSI over 75 or under 30, beta 1.8+, quality under 50. CLEAR if none.
Risk Flags.formula: EARNINGS_NEAR: 0<=DaysToEarnings<=14 | BELOW_SMA200: price<SMA200 | BELOW_SMA50: price<SMA50 | RSI_OVERBOUGHT: RSI14>=75 | RSI_OVERSOLD: RSI14<=30 | HIGH_BETA: Beta>=1.8 | LOW_QUALITY: QualityScore<50. Missing data never raises a flag. Pipe-delimited; none = CLEAR.

Earnings In.plain: Calendar days from the screener run date to the next earnings date. Fixed at run time, so it ages on a static page.
Earnings In.formula: (NextEarningsDate - date.today() at run time).days; yfinance earningsTimestampStart (else earningsTimestamp); blank if unavailable; negative = date already passed.

IV.plain: Implied volatility of the selected put, shown in percent, as quoted by MarketData.app.

Delta target.plain: The screener picks the put whose absolute delta is closest to 0.20, at the expiry closest to 30 days.
Delta target.formula: Puts with bid>0 in a 15-45 day window; pick expiry with DTE nearest 30, then contract with abs(delta) nearest 0.20.

annual_return.plain: Put bid premium divided by strike, scaled up to a full year, in percent. Uses the bid, not the midpoint.

Market regime card.plain: Market-wide 0-100 favorability for selling puts. Tiers: AVOID <30, DEFENSIVE <50, NORMAL <70, FAVORABLE <85, OPTIMAL 85+. Not shown on the 2026-07-25 page.
Market regime card.formula: round(0.40*VIXScore + 0.25*ADScore + 0.15*NewHLScore + 0.10*UpVolScore + 0.10*TRINScore). VIX is ^VIX via yfinance (peak score near VIX 20; <12 scores 15, >40 scores 10). A/D, New H/L, volume and TRIN come from MarketData.app quotes/candles for the whole S&P 500 universe (price_pass frame keeps all rows; PricePass is only a flag). Missing -> 50.
